edition: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006; German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User authorized provisional continuation with Rahlfs–Hanhart; Göttingen not obtained.
scope: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Preserve the distinctive names, repeated affliction, one portion, Eli’s servant as speaker, Adonai/Lord/Eloai Sabaoth, the no-wine/no-iron vow, three-year calf and loan language. Ordinary dialogue uses you/your; Hannah’s prayer at 1:11 retains Thou/Thy/Thee. Smooth Elkanah’s questions and Eli’s blessing without changing the heart image or request.
chapters.pending: Names, quantities, transliterations and vow variants; independent full Greek and apparatus review.
chapters.english_review: Every existing English verse unit individually read and reviewed.

chapters.decision: Preserve the song’s lineation, established heart/horn, hungry leaving the land, divine undertakings, plural our kings and expanded wisdom passage. Thy/Thee remain in 2:1–2. Retain ephoud bar, loan, faithful house/priest and silver obol; modernize ordinary address and third-person verbs.
chapters.pending: Song syntax and images; ephoud bar and sacrificial terminology; full apparatus.
chapters.english_review: Every existing English verse unit individually read and reviewed.

chapters.decision: Keep the lamp being put in order, repeated calling, reviling God and expiated wrongdoing. In 3:9 distinguish Eli addressing Samuel (you) from the nested prayer (Thy servant hears). The same prayer wording appears at 3:10.
chapters.pending: Lamp idiom, reviling and expiation; narrative additions.
chapters.english_review: Every existing English verse unit individually read and reviewed.

chapters.decision: Retain the foreigners’ appeal to the Lord, Eli’s age ninety and twenty years of judging, crushed back and Woe-barchaboth. Name the man and Eli in 4:18 to clarify the pronoun sequence; split 4:20 into spoken English sentences.
chapters.pending: Names and death narrative; unusual numbers and source differences.
chapters.english_review: Every existing English verse unit individually read and reviewed.

chapters.decision: Retain soles of hands, amapheth, ships, seats, buttocks and Ashkelon. Modernize dialogue without substituting familiar readings.

chapters.decision: Preserve propitiation for the personal beneficiaries, bersechthan/ergab, labouring cows, Hosea, Jeconiah and the separate seventy and fifty thousand. Keep all repeated ark language and source-specific details.

chapters.decision: English editorial review only in this chapter. Retain the inherited Greek-based readings including looking after the Lord, groves, Ashkelon to Azob and the old city. No fresh Greek verification is claimed for chapter 7.

chapters.decision: Retain after completion at 8:3 and good cattle herds at 8:16. Preserve the repeated claims of the king and meaningful plural address while modernizing grammar.

chapters.decision: Retain you give the quarter-shekel, Bama, beautiful things, seventy guests and gnaw it. Keep emphatic But you stand here at 9:27.

chapters.decision: Preserve the tombs, leaping men, lavish expenditure, Nasib, nabla/kinyra and you both. In 10:19 the quoted request to appoint a king uses ordinary you, reflecting the request made to Samuel in chapter 8.

chapters.decision: Retain plural you all in 11:3, after morning, Abiezek, six hundred thousand/seventy thousand and Samuel’s anointing and sacrifice. Do not harmonize figures.

chapters.decision: Preserve will sit down, appeasing payment and sandal, the unfinished conditional at 12:14 and will be added at 12:25. Restore Thee in the direct prayer quoted in 12:10.

chapters.decision: Keep the absence of 13:1, Nasib, thirty thousand chariots, could not advance, testimony of the days and tool prices per tooth. Reorder the list of tools at the forge without losing any item.

chapters.decision: Preserve messab, the unusual weapon/stone description, servitude, clear signs/holiness and the people’s prayer for Jonathan. Direct prayer uses Wilt Thou and hast Thou. chapters.decision: Keep Jerim, four hundred thousand/thirty thousand, consoled at 15:11 distinct from regretted at 15:35, hand monument, people’s voice and Israel divided in two. Preserve the violence and ban without embellishment. Modernize ordinary dialogue and shared auxiliaries.

chapters.decision: Use Are these all the boys? at 16:11 for natural English; retain all participants and the youngest. Preserve good before the Lord, choking spirit, gomor and kinyra.

chapters.decision: Retain the filled space between life and death, and if not ellipsis, cities, bringing evils, ergab/amattari, son of deserting girls and completion. Preserve covenant repetition and explicit speakers.

chapters.decision: Keep 21:1 at the source’s chapter boundary, Nomba/Abimelech, Phellani Allemoni, singular he may eat, neessaran, Syrian Doeg, mules and the feigned physical behaviour. Modernize dialogue only where warranted.

chapters.decision: Restore Thy servant in David’s direct prayer. Retain the missing 23:12, four hundred men and difficult Will it be shut up? without choosing a new object. Ordinary speech remains you/your.

chapters.decision: Keep the source’s chapter boundary, heart striking, cloak flap, dead dog and single flea. May the Lord forbid that I should gives natural English for the oath at 24:7; Whom are you pursuing? smooths the question.

chapters.decision: Use lying asleep at 26:7 for the Greek sleep expression without adding soundly. Keep covered carriage, night-raven and stupor. Match 24:7’s oath formula at 26:11; retain the magnified soul and future rescue.
